What We Do

Fisga goes into both futures
before you have to.

Federal Data — 01

Grounded in federal data

Every insight traceable to Census, BLS, FRED, BRFSS, and GSS. Named sources. Visible lineage. Defensible to your board, your CFO, your franchise owner.

Directional — 02

Directional not predictive

We eliminate enough wrong paths that the right direction becomes visible. You still decide. You walk in ready. That distinction matters — and it's what your board needs to hear.

Speed — 03

Minutes not months

Traditional research vendors take weeks. We deliver same-day. That's the white space Fisga was built to occupy.
